name: Tai thumbnail Youtube (luoi xem truoc -> JPG/PNG/WEBP)
description: Dan link kenh hoac link video (moi dong 1 link). Nhan Load de liet ke video va tai anh xem truoc, sau do tick chon anh nao muon luu roi nhan DOWNLOAD. Moi video 1 anh; chon co chung cho ca luoi, video nao khong co co do thi tu lui xuong co gan nhat ben duoi. Ten file = tieu de video. Co anh duoc chot ngay luc Load: doi dropdown co sau khi Load thi phai nhan Load lai. Neu luoi hien trong (khong thay anh nao) thi doi preview_mode tu 'file' sang 'data' trong file JSON nay, khong can build lai app.
